{{Quote|Beware of dangerous beasts, pirates, confusing mazes and a very large and active volcano.|The [[Lok Marathon]] race coordinator, to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:LM">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Swoop race track: "Lok Marathon" on Lok}}</ref>}}
'''Mount Chaolt''' was a massive [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG:MC" /> The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] later renamed the volcano to '''Adi's Rest''' to honor his fellow [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|11|Adi's Rest}}</ref> the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who fought with him during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Occupation of Karthakk|invasion]] of Lok.<ref name="JS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Yes, there's a great need for liquid filtration supplies throughout the galaxy and the Empire has been trying to corner the market. Fortunately, this volcano produces excellent deposits of one type of coagulant.|[[Dak Vox]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:IWIA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|I Want It All|Lok}}</ref>}}
[[File:Lok_Marathon.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Pilots racing near Mount Chaolt during the [[Lok Marathon]].]]
A [[Droid Engineer's Cave|cave]] inhabited by a crazy [[Sardeya Elgrin|droid engineer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was located in the hearth of the volcano.<ref name="SWG:DEC" /> Contestants of the [[Lok Marathon]] had to race through the heights of the volcano.<ref name="SWG:LM" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Dak Vox]] had set up camp on the volcano in order to mine rocks containing deposits of raw cationic chemical coagulant.<ref name="SWG:IWIA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operative under the orders of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Veers]] assassinated the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Raphael Mar-Shayal]] on the slopes of Mount Chaolt.<ref name="SWG:ItDotDS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|Investigating the Destruction of the Death Star|Naboo}}</ref> Around the same time, a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] shipped contraband to [[Edwyn]] who operated on Mount Chaolt.<ref name="SWG:SC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Smuggler|Smuggle Contraband|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mount Chaolt was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The volcano was known both as Mount Chaolt and as Adi's Rest in the game. Mount Chaolt was used in the list of [[W:c:swg:Point of interest|point of interests]]<ref name="SWG:MC" /> and during the Lok Marathon<ref name="SWG:LM" /> while Adi's Rest was only used for the [[W:c:swg:Exploration badges|exploration badge]] awarded to players climbing the volcano.<ref name="SWG:SMoAR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Badge: "Steaming Maw of "Adi's Rest" " on Lok</ref>

''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' identified the volcano "Mount Explosallot". This was corrected in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide]]''.<ref name="guides">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide]]'', ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide]]''</ref>
